log.text: Orchard cuttings for Lantern Reach. Preferred arrival: day 26. Road closes on day 32.
Left Fernwake with 1 companions. Space follows the road; every decision waits for you.
Visitors at the wagon.
Defend the wagon / scavengers.
Withdraw: up to 8 food and 8 cargo left behind.
Your hauler needs rest or a replacement. Open Crew to assign a ready draft companion.
Spent a quiet day recovering. Well-fed companions regain up to 40 stamina and 20 condition.
Your companions find a sheltered patch of grass. For a while, all you hear is chewing.
Moss learned Steady pull. Select it at the departure depot.
Reached Split Oak.
Mara waves as you return to your wagon. No supplies or energy spent.
Reached Split Oak.
Lay a root trail into the waybasket.
Loamling #2 / Tucks the last root into its straw waybasket. Party / 2 of 4 / 3 meals per day.
Reached Split Oak.
Set out for Mossbell Outpost.
Something answers a call from far beyond the trail. Your companions pause to listen.
Buttons learned Careful digging. Select it at the departure depot.
A tempting root patch.
Gather with Loamling.
Reached Mossbell Outpost.
Shade the roost cloth; leave a meal.
Bellmoth #3 / Folds its wings inside your shaded roost cloth. Party / 3 of 4 / 4 meals per day.
Reached Mossbell Outpost.
Medicine and a day of care helped Moss.
Set out for Willowford.
A windblown leaf becomes a very important chase. The road feels shorter afterward.
Lumen learned Patient scouting. Select it at the departure depot.
A platform in the reeds.
You record the resting platforms along the shallow margin. No supplies or energy spent.
Reached Willowford.
Measured Willowford's current and noted recent rain.
The ferryman brings the wagon safely across.
Set out for Cairn Gate.
Tracks in loose shale.
Use a repair board as a lever.
A broad tree offers a little shade. Your wagon rolls through its cool shadow.
Reached Cairn Gate.
Set out for Lantern Reach.
A patient traveling companion.
Make room for Slatewhorl.
Slatewhorl #4 / Party / 4 of 4 / 5 meals per day.
Provisions cover fewer than three days. Forage, reduce rations, or visit Mossbell.
There was not enough food today. The crew is weaker.
The orchard cuttings reach Lantern Reach in time. There will be new trees here next spring.
